traits.capitulum_kind.note: Flora of North America (Conyza canadensis, vol. 20, read on efloras.org 2026-11-04): involucres 3-4 mm; receptacles 1-1.5(-3) mm diam. in fruit; pistillate florets 20-30(-45+), laminae 0.3-1 mm; disc florets 8-30+; cypselae 1-1.5 mm; pappi of 15-25 white bristles 2-3 mm.
